lounges.location: International departures, fourth floor, East Wing. Priority Pass directs travelers near Gates 21–22; the operator still references Gate 28.

lounges.note: This is the East Wing lounge, not SH Premium Ha Noi 3 or the domestic T1 lounge. Follow the current signs because the operator and membership directories differ on the nearby gate number.

recommendation.summary: An international Priority Pass option with a buffet and verified showers; visits are limited to three hours.

qualityRating.summary: A December 2025 visit to the international SH lounge found a calm, well-arranged space and enjoyed the noodle counter and bar. The rest of the buffet was respectable rather than exceptional; this is a single-visit assessment.
